concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-classic-platforms-payouts-manual-payout-payout-to-cards]] — 2021-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Classic manual payout-to-card guide with Support/PCI/eligibility gates, stored payout method and asynchronous update/payout notifications; request receipt does not prove card credit.
warnings: Raw line 88 says recurring detail reference is needed for future payout requests, while Step 3 at raw lines 142–160 sends payoutMethodCode; preserve this identifier difference.
Step 2 example submitted and returned recurringDetailReference values differ at raw lines 105–106 and 125–129; do not derive identity from sample values.
The 30-minute cardholder arrival statement at raw line 23 is dated guidance, not proof of a particular card credit.
